brief.prompt: A clean, simple illustration of a human skull in side profile on a soft cream background, with the lower jawbone rendered in a distinct warm coral colour while the rest of the skull is pale grey. The scene shows only the skull, no lettering or markings of any kind.
brief.alt: Stylised side-view illustration of a human skull with the lower jawbone highlighted in coral
brief.purpose: Teaches the 'What the Jawline Is Made Of' section: the mandible is the movable lower jawbone whose shape underlies the visible jawline.

review.alt: Side-view illustration of a pale grey human skull on a cream background with the lower jawbone (mandible) highlighted in coral, showing the ramus, angle, chin and teeth.
